main_text.p: שְׁכִיבָא שְׁכִיב Ch. & Syr. Jacens, decumbens morbo, ægrotus, Eccles. 3. 2. Dormiens: Qui occubuit, obiit, mortuus, Ruth. 1. 8. & 4. 10. Numer. 19. 11. in Jon. Plur. שְׁכִיבָא, שְׁכִיבִין.
שְׁכוּבְתָּא, שְׁכוּבָא & שׁוּכְבָא, שְׁכָבָא Ch. Cubatio, concubitus, Levit. 15. 16. 17. Lev. 20. 15.
מְשָׁכְבָא, מִשְׁכַּב Chald. Cubatus, cubile, lectum, stratum, Levit. 15. 4. Judic. 15. 1. Concubitus, Genes. 49. 4. Numer. 31. 18.
מַשְׁכּוּבִיתָא Ch. Aries, ductor gregis, Genes. 30. 40. in Jonat. In Aruch explicatur הבהמה המהלכת בראש הערר שישלה זוג והצאן נמשכין אחריה & משכוביה & ברשכתא Vide illic.
main_text.head: שכח
main_text.p: Aph. אַשְׁכַּח, in qua conjugatione potissimum usurpatur, Ch. & Syr. Invenire, reperire, deprehendere, assequi, consequi. Unde Syris quoque significat Posse, valere. Ithpehal. אִשְׁתְּכַח, Inventus, repertus est. Ithpah. אִשְׁתַּכַּח Idem.
שׁכח S. Inveniens, potes, possibile: שׁכח Impossibile. Fœm. שׁכחא.
שְׁכַל* Quæ hinc sunt vide in שכל.
main_text.head: שְׁכַלל
main_text.p: Pahel Ch. Perficere, absolvere, consummare, finire: fundare, fundamentum ponere. Quadratum ex כלל. Ithpahel אִשְׁתַּכְלַל Perfici, absolvi, finiri: fundari.
שְׁכְלוּל Ch. Perfectio, consummatio, absolutio, Genes. 7. 11. in Targ. Jonath.

page.notes: Hebrew and Aramaic words are printed in Hebrew letters with vowel points; the transcription of the pointed forms is approximate where the scan is blurred. The asterisk after שְׁכַל is printed. Some Hebrew entries in the lines with שׁכח and the diagrams of word forms are partly illegible at the right edge.
